2022

Author: Anuja Prabhudessai

902 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2259 Of 2022
 Arif Kasim Inamdar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
..Applicant
 v/s.
 The State of Maharashtra .

..Respondent
 Mr. Veerdhaval Kakade for the Applicant.
 Mr. A.A.Palkar, App for the State.

Coram : Anuja Prabhudessai,J.
Dated : 23rd August, 2022.

The Applicant herein has sought pre-arrest bail in Crime No.276 of 2022 registered with Fauzdar Chawdi Police Station for offences under Section 188, 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code and for offences under Section 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e), 3 and 59 of the Food and Safety Standards Act,
2006.
2.
It is stated that the offence under Section 328 of IPC is the only non-bailable offence with maximum imprisonment for 10 years and triable by the Court of Sessions.
It is stated that the question relating to the applicability of Section 328 of IPC in such cases is pending before the Honourable Supreme Court.
It is stated that the other Applicants with similar accusation have been released on interim bail by this Court.
Copy of order dated 05.08.2022 in ABA/482 of 2022 and other group Digitally matters is placed on record.
signed by PRASANNA P PRASANNA P SALGAONKAR SALGAONKAR

sentences.text: Considering the nature of accusation, in the event of arrest, the Applicant is granted interim bail on the following terms and conditions:-

(I) In the event of arrest of the Applicant in Crime No.276 of 2022 registered with Fauzdar Chawdi Police Station, the Applicant be released on interim bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.30,000/- (Thirty Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.

(ii) The Applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer for four days w.e.f.
29.08.022 between 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m.
(iii) The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
(iv) The Applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of Fauzdar Chawdi Police Station without prior permission of the Court, till the next date of hearing.
4. Stand over to 12.09.2022.
To be listed along with ABA/482 /2022 and other group matters.

(ANUJA PRABHUDESSAI, J.)
